biology: Host: Schima (Schima superba); specimens collected from its roots.
soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles brown and slightly transparent, pilosity of the head capsule rather dense. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.58–0.61, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin nearly straight. Frontal region slightly raised, slightly concave between the peaks. Labrum ligulate, broadly rounded at the apex, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae of nearly equal length, the setae in the middle of the labral surface also rather long. Mandibles long and strong, apex slightly elongate and curved, mandibular basal ridge distinct; length 0.57–0.61 of head capsule length and 0.96–1.03 of head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, its anterior lateral margins trapezoidal; waist region slender and long with parallel margins, waist constriction index 0.26–0.30. Pronotum trapezoidal, 1.43–1.54 times as wide as long, anterior margin shallowly notched in the middle, posterior margin nearly straight; nearly 30 long setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
